note: Decile bins; marker area reflects sample size. S_selected uses calibrators fitted on earlier, separate quarters. These curves describe test performance, not calibration training.

title: 9. Identity, threshold, basket and attrition sensitivities
note: Each scenario names its own population/threshold. Reduced metadata can create false merges; no new links are promoted. All comparisons are exploratory.

title: 10. Dependence-aware uncertainty sensitivity
note: Nominal 95% intervals, 1,000 draws; 13 waves. Joint method is post hoc exploratory, stress coverage 0.86. Selected-policy interval crosses zero; no universal coverage claim.

title: 11. Associative feature-group diagnostics across 2024 quarters
note: Three permutations per feature group per quarter; selected calibrators fixed. Correlated features and off-manifold combinations limit interpretation; no causal effects.

title: 12. Evidence gates determine the supported study scope
note: Counts are an evidence inventory, not a publication probability or readiness percentage. See the gate ledger for the distinct consequences of each unresolved gate.
